title: platform-standup-2026-03-22
content:
Platform Engineering Standup - 2026-03-22
Attendees: Asha (owner), Ben, Marta, Luis, Riley, Dev (notes)
Location: Zoom / #platform-team on Slack

Quick agenda:
- Control plane: rollout and migration status
- Routing: multi-region routing fallback tests
- Auth: KMS integration and token expiry handling
- Quotas: throttling rules and customer impact
- Blockers / action items

Notes:
1) Control plane
- Deployment: Canary 2 for control-plane v1.14 went out last night to us-west-2 (10% traffic). Observed 1.8% increase in 5xxs for short-lived admin calls; traced to cache warmup race.
- Mitigation: rolled back Canary 2 at 03:20 UTC and applied hotfix (PR #487) to add a short mutex around cache priming. Hotfix deployed at 04:10 UTC, metrics returned to baseline by 04:30 UTC.
- Follow-up: add stronger idempotency to cache-priming logic and unit tests for concurrent startup case. Owner: Ben. Jira: PLAT-412.
- Migration: database migration for routing rules (migration-2026-03-21) completed in staging; production migration scheduled 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC (maintenance window). Note: need support from SRE for rollback plan.

2) Routing
- Multi-region routing tests: Marta ran synthetic failover tests between eu-west-1 and us-west-2. Cutover latency median ~120ms, p95 ~260ms which is within SLO for most routes but a few internal routes spike to ~420ms.
- Root cause: a subset of routes still using legacy connector that does an extra handshake. Patch prepared to skip handshake for compatible SDK versions. PR opened, review requested.
- Action: schedule canary for 2026-03-23 in eu region; coordinate with network team to monitor inter-region bandwidth. Owner: Marta. Jira: PLAT-423.

3) Auth
- KMS integration: Riley completed KMS rotation tooling to support staged key rollovers. Currently in integration test.
- Token expiry: one customer reported intermittent 401s after token refresh when using private deployments behind an old LB. Root cause likely clock skew + aggressive caching of JWKS.
- Workaround: lowered JWKS cache TTL to 30s for private deployments; longer term fix: implement TTL-aware cache invalidation. Owner: Riley + Solutions Eng to notify impacted customers.

4) Quotas
- Quota engine: Luis finished a refactor to make rule evaluation O(1) for common cases. Benchmarks: 3x reduction in p99 evaluation time under synthetic load.
- Throttling incidents: we saw two customers hit burst throttles during a AB-test rollout; hits were legitimate traffic spikes. Need to improve backoff guidance in client SDKs and consider adaptive bursts for paying customers.
- Action: prepare a short SDK change to expose exponential backoff helper; propose adaptive-burst feature for Discuss next week. Owner: Luis.

Blockers / Risks:
- SRE bandwidth next week is limited (on-call + infra migration). We should delay non-critical production migrations by 48h if SRE signoff not confirmed.
- Concurrency bug in control-plane cache warmup still needs a unit/integration test to prevent recurrence.
- Coordination required between platform routing patch and network (ticket NN-311) to avoid traffic blips during canary.

Decisions made:
- Rollback of Canary 2 was the right call; hotfix to be merged to main after two approvals.
- Production routing migration will remain 2026-03-24 but we will add an additional verification step and SRE on-call into the runbook.

Action items (owners):
- Ben: Add unit tests for cache priming concurrency and finish PLAT-412 (due 2026-03-25).
- Marta: Prepare routing-canary plan and notify network team; schedule canary 2026-03-23 (due 2026-03-23).
- Riley: Finish KMS rotation integration tests and coordinate with Solutions Eng on customer communication for token 401s (due 2026-03-24).
- Luis: Draft SDK backoff helper PR and outline adaptive-burst proposal (due 2026-03-26).
- Asha: Update runbook with rollback playbook and confirm SRE availability for 2026-03-24 migration (due 2026-03-23).

Misc / Follow-ups:
- Post-incident mini-retro to be scheduled for 2026-03-26 to review the control-plane canary rollback (owner: Asha).
- Add a short note to the Sprint board linking PLAT-412 and PLAT-423 so PMs have visibility.
- Related links: Confluence design doc, PR #487, monitoring dashboard (grafana link pinned in Slack).

Casual notes / comms to send after standup:
- Quick FYI to #platform-team: rolled back control-plane canary, hotfix applied, monitoring shows stable. Will post retro + action items.

End of notes.
